attempts.summary: Created the opsbot local account on node1 and node2 (RHEL 7.9, password locked on both). Generated an ed25519 keypair for opsbot on node1 and installed the public key as node2's opsbot authorized_keys, giving node1's opsbot passwordless SSH access to run commands as opsbot on node2. Added a `Match User opsbot` sshd block on both nodes (PubkeyAuthentication yes, PasswordAuthentication no, AuthenticationMethods publickey) and reloaded sshd, so opsbot requires key-based auth on both systems (verified password attempts are rejected with "Permission denied (publickey)"). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on both nodes: captured baseline boot_id, restarted, polled until reachable, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified opsbot's identity, sshd pubkey-only policy, and working cross-node key auth after each restart.
